orca-agent-flyout.notes: Read-only source inventory. Counts use one representative per data-driven control and group alternate activation paths when they invoke the same action. Reach starts with the fresh Orca terminal and local sample-project fixture from ui-snapshot/capture.py:161–176,352–387. Reach steps may refer to other inventory IDs. Supported means the current case format can express the action and listed in-app evidence. It does not mean a native run passed. Each missing entry names its first blocking capability, so later steps may need another helper. The fixture helper would provision additional disposable state, locateControl would identify unlabeled or non-pressable controls, imageAssert would verify a specific visual state, and scroll would expose the Swift wheel action as an asserted case step. Ordinary hover tints, focus borders, delegated built-in dialog internals and render measurements are not separate actions. Tooltips used as locators are identified in notes. Native app and live config were not accessed.
